thread:
ravi desai: ran a walkthrough with a PM today and found a couple of edge-case things in the Private setup wizard networking step we should tidy before the next release: 1) our CIDR helper doesn't mention zero-compression variants (users typed ::/128 and got confused), 2) the probe list on mobile grows huge and pushes the next step offscreen, and 3) keyboard users want a clear way to jump to the first failing check. little design + a11y ask.
maia nguyen: thanks — for CIDR examples i can add a compact inline toggle that expands to show more variants: default helper: "Control-plane CIDR (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16 or fd00::/64)" and the expanded panel shows: "Also accepted: ::/128, 2001:db8::/32, fd00:abcd::/48". keeps the main form short.
jamal taylor: aria/a11y notes: 1) validator should accept standard IPv6 compressed forms; i'll switch validation to ipaddr.js so we don't miss cases. 2) add a skip link "Skip to first failing check" at the top that focuses the failing probe opener. 3) make the probe list role="list" with each probe role="listitem" and give failing items aria-current="true" when focused.
andrew liu: mobile UX: default to compact rows (single-line summary with pill + duration). add a small "Show details" chevron per row. introduce a persistent "Preserve logs" toggle so support can keep the last run's full logs across refreshes. when details open, make it a side-drawer that overlays but does not trap focus; Esc closes and focus returns to the chevron.

ravi desai: for copy tone — users get scared when we say "Repair". proposals: "Apply suggested fix" (primary) + secondary "View steps". if the fix touches infra, show a modal confirmation explaining the change.
maia nguyen: agree. microcopy snippets: "Preserve logs (for support)", "Show full CIDR examples" (toggle), and confirmation modal title: "Apply suggested network change?" body: "This will attempt to modify firewall rules for the control plane. If you're unsure, choose View steps."
jamal taylor: implementation checklist: capture opener before details open (const opener = document.activeElement), focus drawer header on open, on close call opener?.focus?.(); add aria-live="polite" on the compact status text for incremental updates and role="alert" toast on hard failures. also add visible focus styles for the chevron button.
andrew liu: small CSS/interaction notes: compact row should be 44px tall, label left, pill & duration right. when a probe fails show a thin left border in brand-accent + icon + text; avoid color-only indicators. move the help link inline next to the field label as a small icon-button so it is first in tab order after the input.
design-bot: screenshot: https://files.redwood.ai/ux/edge-cidr-compact-probes-202610.png :camera_with_flash: mock shows compact rows + preserve-logs toggle + "Show full CIDR examples" expander.
ravi desai: one more thing — can we add an optional breadcrumb-like summary at the top of the step: "Networking: 3 passed • 1 attention" where each segment is a link into the list. keyboard users can Tab to the summary and press Enter to jump. good quick scan.
maia nguyen: microcopy for the summary: "Networking: 3 passed • 1 attention (Jump to issue)". tooltip on attention: "Some checks need manual review."
jamal taylor: for testing add an e2e keyboard scenario: open wizard -> Tab to summary -> Enter jumps to failing item -> Expand details -> Esc closes -> focus returns to row. also add unit tests for IPv6 compressed forms.
andrew liu: i'll prototype the compact CSS and drawer interactions, and wire the Preserve logs toggle to local storage. ravi, i'll open a PR tomorrow.
ravi desai: action items: maia — PR for helper copy + expanded CIDR examples; jamal — validator bump + aria changes + tests; andrew — compact row + drawer + preserve-logs prototype + e2e. aim to land before the next patch release. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
